run_train_searcher: run the script to train a scaNN nearest neighbor searcher from NPZ embedding files
run_load_datapool: run load_datapool to load patch embeddings from one or more NPZ files into a dictionary
run_search_bruteforce: run search_bruteforce to build a brute force scaNN searcher for small embedding pools
run_search_ah: run search_ah to build an asymmetric hashing scaNN searcher with reordering for medium pools
run_search_partioned_ah: run search_partioned_ah to build a partitioned asymmetric hashing scaNN searcher for large pools
